# ANFA Interior — Turnkey Residential Interiors & Modular Furniture PCMC Pune

> ANFA Interior is an authentic direct-contractor residential interior design and modular woodworking company founded by Akhlaque Chaudhary (12+ years master carpenter and contractor). Operating an in-house fabrication workshop in Kudalwadi, Chikhali, ANFA delivers 100% IS 710 BWP Marine Plywood interiors with Hettich/Hafele hardware across Moshi, Spine Road, Chikhali, Tathawade, Ravet, and Pimpri-Chinchwad (PCMC), Pune at direct workshop rates (20-30% below studio aggregators).

## Key Facts & Verification Signals
- **Founder**: Akhlaque Chaudhary (Principal Craftsman & Turnkey Contractor)
- **Direct Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 70402 08012 (070402 08012)
- **Registered Workshop Address**: Gat No. 696, Patti Wali Galli, Near Maharashtra Kata, Kudalwadi, Chikhali, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Pune, Maharashtra 411062, India
- **Core Specialization**: Turnkey 1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK flat interiors, modular acrylic/laminate kitchens, custom sliding wardrobes, false ceilings, ambient lighting, and complete home renovation.
- **Service Territory**: Moshi, Spine Road, Chikhali, Sector 16, Bhosari, Nigdi, Ravet, Tathawade, Punawale, Wakad, Pimpri Chinchwad, Pune.
- **Material Standards**: 100% IS 710 BWP (Boiling Water Proof) Marine Grade Plywood, 0.8mm-1.0mm Merino/Century high-pressure laminates, Hettich & Hafele soft-close hardware, 710 Marine ply kitchen carcasses.
- **Guarantees**: 45-Day handover guarantee, 10-Year structural termite & moisture warranty, 0% middleman commission markup.
- **Verified Video Evidence**: Real on-site YouTube video tours of completed projects (Kohinoor Sapphire Tathawade, Swadesha Chikhali, Moshi Spine Road flats).

## Pricing Summary (Direct Workshop Rates)
- **1BHK Essential Package**: ₹2.8 Lakh – ₹4.2 Lakh (Modular Kitchen + Master Wardrobe + TV Unit + Basic False Ceiling)
- **2BHK Complete Turnkey Package**: ₹4.8 Lakh – ₹7.2 Lakh (Full Kitchen + 2 Bed Wardrobes + Living TV Unit + POP Ceiling + Painting)
- **3BHK Premium Turnkey Package**: ₹7.5 Lakh – ₹12.5 Lakh (Full Flat Furnishing + Crokery + Dressing + Profile Lighting + PU/Acrylic Finishes)
- **Modular Kitchen Only**: ₹1.2 Lakh – ₹2.8 Lakh (depending on shape: Straight, L-Shape, Parallel, or U-Shape)
